events.title: Section 232 minimum-import-price floor on polysilicon/solar takes effect
events.why_it_matters: Minimum-import-price floors on polysilicon (USD 21/kg), ingots/wafers (USD 100/kg), solar cells (USD 0.22/W) and solar modules (USD 0.38/W) take effect for US goods entered for consumption from 00:01 ET on this date, plus a flat tariff; US polysilicon/wafer/cell capacity behind the floor is the un-mapped side of a headline solar-tariff story dominated by module assemblers.
events.source_name: Wiley, Trump Administration Imposes Section 232 Tariffs and Minimum Import Prices on Polysilicon and its Derivatives

events.title: China's rare-earth export-control suspension expires
events.why_it_matters: MOFCOM Announcements No. 61 and 62 of 2025 (export controls on rare-earth mining, smelting/separation, metal production, magnet manufacturing and related technology and recycling) are suspended only from 2026-11-07 to this fixed date; whether Beijing renews, narrows or lets the suspension lapse resets the whole downstream magnet-supply-chain thesis inside the window, and MOFCOM has not stated its reasoning either way.

events.title: IMO extraordinary MEPC session reconvenes to vote on the Net-Zero Framework
events.why_it_matters: The October 2025 extraordinary session adjourned for twelve months without adopting the framework; the reconvened session (October 2026, exact dates set by IMO) decides whether shipping gets the first global carbon price, applying to ships over 5,000 GT from 2028 with remedial units priced at USD 380 and USD 100 per tonne CO2e. Adoption and non-adoption are both large and opposite; the un-mapped side is bunkering infrastructure for methanol and ammonia, onboard capture, and engine retrofit yards rather than the listed liner operators everyone already watches.
events.source_name: IMO press briefing, IMO net-zero shipping talks to resume in 2026

events.title: Euro 7 applies to new M1/N1 vehicle types in the EU
events.why_it_matters: New car and van types need Euro 7 type approval from this date; all new M1/N1 vehicles from 2027-11-29, and heavy duty types from 2028-05-29 with all new heavy vehicles from 2029-05-29. Euro 7 regulates brake particulates, tyre abrasion and battery durability for the first time, so the exposed links are friction-material and brake-pad makers, tyre compounders and on-board monitoring sensors, not the OEM badges the coverage follows.
events.source_name: EUR-Lex summary, Vehicle emissions and battery durability (Euro 7)

events.title: EU Deforestation Regulation applies to large and medium operators
events.why_it_matters: After a one-year postponement, large and medium operators and traders must file due-diligence statements with geolocation for cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber, soya and wood placed on the EU market; small operators follow on 2027-06-30. The visible story is the commodity price; the un-mapped links are plot-level traceability software, certification and lab testing houses, and the re-routing of non-compliant volumes to non-EU buyers.
events.source_name: European Parliament press release, Deforestation law: Parliament adopts changes to postpone and simplify measures

events.title: EU prohibition on Russian LNG imports under long-term contracts takes effect
events.why_it_matters: Regulation EU/261/2026 closes the last legal channel for Russian LNG into the EU from this date (short-term contracts were already banned in 2026); long-term pipeline contracts follow by 2027-09-30, at the latest 2027-11-01. Roughly 35 bcm/y of supply has to be replaced by seaborne cargoes, which moves tonne-miles, charter rates, regasification slot values and US/Qatari offtake, none of which is a headline the Russian-gas story usually reaches.
events.source_name: European Commission, REPowerEU - phase out of Russian energy imports

events.title: CBAM certificate sales open; first surrender due 2027-09-30
events.why_it_matters: Authorised declarants start buying CBAM certificates for emissions embedded in 2026 imports of steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and electricity, and must surrender them by 2027-09-30. This is the first date EU importers actually pay a carbon price at the border rather than only report one; the un-mapped links are emissions verification and measurement services, low-carbon feedstock suppliers who can now price a premium, and the non-EU producers who lose the arbitrage.
events.source_name: DEHSt (German Emissions Trading Authority), CBAM certificates

events.title: FCC must close the Upper C-band auction (160 MHz, 3.98-4.14 GHz) by its statutory July 2027 deadline
events.why_it_matters: The FCC adopted rules on 2026-07-22 to auction 160 MHz of Upper C-band, 60 percent more than the statutory minimum, creating a 440 MHz harmonised mid-band block with the Lower C-band and raising tens of billions for the Treasury. Carriers are the obvious side; the un-mapped links are the satellite operators being cleared and compensated, radio-altimeter retrofit suppliers serving the adjacent aviation band, and the filter and RAN vendors who have to ship a new band plan.
events.source_name: FCC news release, FCC Adopts Plan for C-Band Auction in July 2027

events.title: EU ETS2 becomes fully operational for buildings and road transport fuels
events.why_it_matters: Postponed by one year to 2028, ETS2 puts a carbon price on heating and road fuel across the EU, with the first allowance surrender due 31 May 2029 and early auctioning expected during 2027. The regulated entity is the fuel supplier, not the household, which is exactly the link most commentary skips; downstream of it sit heat pumps, building retrofit trades, biofuel blenders and the Social Climate Fund disbursements.
events.source_name: European Commission, ETS2: buildings, road transport and additional sectors

events.title: Grasberg returns to full production per Freeport guidance (end-2027)
events.why_it_matters: After the mud rush and force majeure, Freeport still guides Grasberg back to full rates by end-2027, with copper output rebuilding to about 1.5 billion lb in 2027 and 1.7 billion lb in 2028. events.title: Eliquis US generic entry date agreed in patent settlements
events.why_it_matters: Pfizer and BMS settled with a number of generic filers permitting US launch of generic apixaban on 1 April 2028; the composition-of-matter patent runs to 2026-11-21 (2027-05-21 with pediatric exclusivity) and the formulation patent to 2031, so adverse appellate outcomes could pull the date forward. A multi-billion dollar brand converts to generic on a known day; the un-mapped links are API and finished-dose manufacturers with ANDAs already approved, and the Part D redesign interaction that changes who actually captures the saving.
